list.name: 변경
list.comment:
Update framework2 to migrate dependencies and improve compatibility.
- Migrated from Ehcache to Caffeine for improved caching performance. - Updated Redis implementation to use Jedis Pool API for better resource management. - Replaced deprecated Apache Velocity with VelocityEngine. - Refactored HTTP utility classes to use CloseableHttpClient for better resource handling. - Upgraded dependencies and adjusted `.classpath` to ensure compatibility with Jakarta EE and Java 17+. - Added `log4j2.xml` configuration for enhanced logging capabilities. - Updated `web.xml` to align with Jakarta EE 6.0 specifications.
